assertions: Native namespace/validity stack and actual typed property slots drive application-neutral manifest reading.
Writer reuses actual package metadata and document defaults when XML streams or Standard declarations are absent.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task178 implements actual plain ManifestImport namespace/validity scopes,fixed native property slots and real PropertyValue/Any output plus ManifestReader SAX-failure empty-result behavior. Existing SAL signed64 parser is reused through missing terminated C and const OUString entry points,including embedded-zero termination and exact overflow behavior. Source-owned plain ZipPackage metadata/MIME fallback/conflict and ZipPackageFolder consistency operate on actual ZipFile catalogs with real stream/folder properties;no storage/service class is fabricated. Preserve duplicate metadata application,first Version fallback,unknown namespace/invalid-parent leniency and recursive folder assignment CALC162..164;native unordered binary bucket order is not simulated. Writer uses the shared reader and native absent-stream early returns with actual SwDoc defaults;remove the noncanonical mandatory Standard-definition guard and adapt font existence checks to actual applied stream metadata. Retire the duplicated Writer-only shared manifest validator without a compatibility alias. Existing ZIP32,depth/declaration/XML-byte admission bounds remain explicit. Encryption,writable storage/full UNO parser/stream/component services,complete Calc document/UI/same-model ODS remain pending;physical memory/refcount/cache machinery is not added and broad parity stays unverified.
